desc:
Squarespace SEO and speed optimization makes your pages easier for search engines to understand and quicker for visitors to open. Ecom Swift LLC fixes titles, headings, redirects, images and scripts, then shares before and after test results.

## What is Squarespace SEO and speed optimization?

Squarespace SEO and speed optimization is the work of adjusting a site's settings, structure and media so that search engines can read it and visitors do not wait for it. SEO covers page titles, descriptions, headings, URL slugs, image names, alt text, redirects, structured data and Search Console. Speed covers image size, heavy blocks, scripts, fonts and video loading.

Squarespace handles many technical basics for you, but what you put into each page is still your responsibility.

## Why does Squarespace SEO still need work?

Squarespace provides a sitemap, clean code and mobile-ready templates, yet it cannot write your page titles or decide your heading order. Many sites ship with the default title, a missing description or three different top-level headings on one page. Photos uploaded straight from a camera can be many times larger than needed.

Those gaps leave search engines guessing what each page is about and leave visitors waiting on a phone connection.

## How SEO and speed affect leads and sales

Search results show your title and description before anyone visits. A clear title that matches what people type invites the click. Once visitors arrive, a page that opens quickly keeps them there, and a page that jumps around while loading frustrates them.

We cannot promise ranking positions, because search results depend on competition, content and many outside factors. What we can do is remove the technical and wording problems that stand in the way.

## What good Squarespace SEO and speed work includes

- Unique titles and descriptions for each important page.
- One main heading per page, with sub-headings in a logical order.
- Short, readable URL slugs.
- Image file names and alt text that describe what is shown.
- Search Console connected and the sitemap checked.
- Redirects for any address that changes.
- Schema markup added to the pages that benefit from it most.
- Large images compressed and heavy blocks or scripts trimmed.
- Fonts and video set to load without delaying the page.
- Internal links that lead visitors from one page to the next.

## How we work

We test your pages on mobile, record the starting results and review your settings page by page. We then rewrite titles, tidy headings and slugs, resize media and remove what slows the page. When an address must change, we add a redirect so old links keep working.

The Basic package covers key pages and image cleanup. Standard widens the work across the site, adds structured data, redirects and script trimming, and records speed tests before and after. Premium covers a full pass with a keyword map, blog and product settings, internal links and a plan for the next quarter.

## Do and avoid

**Do:**
- Tell us which products, services or locations matter most.
- Use descriptive file names when you upload photos.
- Write for people first, then check for search terms.
- Keep a record of any address you change.

**Avoid:**
- Stuffing one phrase into each line of a page.
- Changing page addresses with no redirect.
- Uploading full camera-size photos.
- Expecting overnight movement in search results.

## Who this is for

A local business wants to appear when nearby customers search. A writer with years of blog posts wants old pages to be found and to load quickly. A shop owner whose product pages share the same title needs each one to stand apart.

## What we need from you

Send your site address, your main search terms and any Search Console access you have. We never ask for passwords. Invite us as a contributor with the permissions needed to edit pages and settings, and add us to Search Console as a user if you want us to check its data.
